findings.description: Recovery after a missing pinned snapshot dispatches to <home>/current, which the scenario never establishes; on a fresh machine without current the recovery path is undefined.
findings.suggestion: Add the <home>/current precondition or define recovery when current is absent.

citations.excerpt: Then the shim dispatches the runtime subcommand to "<home>/current"

findings.description: AC-016 gives a dev-lock project exactly one INFO even if the dev source checkout is missing, while the shim fails there; status would under-report an unusable runtime.
findings.suggestion: Report an ERROR when the dev source is missing or not a LiveSpec checkout.

findings.description: Removing write permissions before renaming a snapshot into versions/ may fail on some platforms; no cleanup path is described for a corrupt snapshot.
findings.suggestion: Chmod after rename or stage inside versions/; document corrupt-snapshot removal.

citations.excerpt: H[Remove write permissions and rename into place]

findings.description: SC-003 bounds reads to one lock and one manifest; a dev lock has no manifest, so the dev-mode read bound is implicit.
findings.suggestion: State the dev-lock read bound in SC-003.

citations.excerpt: read at most one lock and one manifest

findings.description: Stack lists only the editable install; the constitution and ADR-004 add runtime snapshots and a CLI shim not yet recorded in the stack.
